note: The exact creation code Olien v1 was deployed from, on Arc testnet and Monad testnet. Deploying these bytes through the deployer below lands on the same four addresses on any chain; recompiling the source does not, because the compiler appends a hash of the source paths and this repository moved them. ops/deploy-olien.sh sends these bytes, and contracts/test/OlienCanonical.t.sol holds them to the source.
